# Milwaukee Journal Sentinel

> The Milwaukee Journal Sentinel is Wisconsin's premier news source for breaking news, sports coverage, investigations, and local community information.

jsonline.com serves the Milwaukee and greater Wisconsin region with comprehensive coverage of news, sports (including Green Bay Packers and Milwaukee Brewers), business, real estate, and lifestyle content. The site combines traditional journalism with digital classifieds and marketplace services.

## Key Topics

- Breaking News
- Wisconsin Politics
- Milwaukee
- Green Bay Packers
- Milwaukee Brewers
- NCAA Tournament

- Arts & Culture
- Wisconsin

## News & Investigations

- [News - Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/news): News section homepage with breaking news, crime reports, and Wisconsin politics.
- [Watchdog and Investigations - Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/watchdog): Investigative journalism and watchdog reporting on police and fraud.
- [Suburbs - Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/communities): Suburban news from Milwaukee, Waukesha, and surrounding counties.

## Sports

- [Sports - Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/sports): Sports section with Wisconsin teams, NCAA tournament, and local sports coverage.
- [Green Bay Packers - Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/sports/packers): Green Bay Packers coverage including roster, trades, and offseason news.

## Business & Real Estate

- [Business and Financial News - Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/business): Business section with Milwaukee economy, real estate, and retail news.
- [Local Real Estate Listings | Milwaukee Homes for Sale](https://www.jsonline.com/real-estate): Real estate listings and property search for Milwaukee and southeast Wisconsin.

## Lifestyle & Entertainment

- [Entertainment | Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/entertainment): Entertainment news covering music, dining, arts, and Milwaukee events.
- [Life | Milwaukee Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/life): Lifestyle section with food, recipes, home, and Wisconsin traditions.

## Classifieds & Marketplace

- [Milwaukee Journal Sentinel Classifieds, Milwaukee, WI](https://subscribe.jsonline.com/rr/nanobar): Classifieds marketplace for Milwaukee Journal Sentinel with local ads and memorials.
- [Milwaukee Shopping Deals & Wisconsin Offers - Journal Sentinel](https://www.jsonline.com/shopping): Shopping deals and discounts for Milwaukee and Wisconsin retailers.
